app.name: Khalesni
app.tagline: Tell me the mess. I'll turn it into a checklist.

greeting.morning: Good morning, {name}. What's on your mind?
greeting.evening: Good evening, {name}. What's on your mind?

chat.placeholder: Tell me what's on your mind…

stage.slow: Still working — map searches can be slow.

notSaved.title: Not saved
notSaved.body: Khalesni wrote this plan but couldn't store it. Ticking won't be remembered.

place.phoneSource: Phone found on {domain} — may be outdated
place.notOnMap: Not on the map — found on {domain}

plans.title: Your plans
plans.empty: No plans yet. Tell Khalesni what's on your mind and it'll build your first checklist.

voice.sub: Khalesni will listen and reply out loud.
voice.busy: Voice is already open in another tab. Close it and try again.
voice.off: Voice mode isn't switched on for this server.
voice.micDenied: Microphone access is off. Enable it in your browser settings.

error.generate: Khalesni couldn't finish that one. It happens with very long or unusual messages.
error.timeout: That took too long. A shorter message usually works.
error.plansDown: Your saved plans aren't reachable right now. You can still chat — new plans just won't be stored.
error.offline: You're offline. Khalesni needs a connection to think.

settings.placesOff: Khalesni can still plan, but it won't suggest specific venues.
settings.voiceOff: Voice mode isn't switched on for this server.
settings.plansOff: New plans won't be stored, but chat still works.

undo.label: Undo
undo.restoredAtEnd: Restored at the end of the list
